browse.title: Browse mods and plugins
browse.description: Search Modrinth, CurseForge, Hangar and SpigotMC for resources that fit this server. Client-only mods are left out.

unreadable.title: Could not be checked
unreadable.description: The node did not answer for {{types}}, so what is installed there could not be verified. Nothing was changed.

pack.chooseDescription: A server runs one pack. Installing one links it here, so its version can be switched and checked for updates later. Only packs with a server side are listed.
pack.upToDate: This pack is on its newest version.
pack.stopRequired: The server has to be stopped before a pack can be installed or switched.
pack.unlinkedLoader: This pack was installed before packs were linked to a loader, so its versions cannot be listed. Install it again to relink it.
pack.noModsOnDisk: None of the pack's mods are on disk any more.

dialog.title: Install {{title}}
dialog.description: Everything is downloaded and checked before the server is touched. If anything fails, the server stays exactly as it was.
dialog.backupHint: A backup is taken before anything is written. If it fails, the install does not start.
dialog.backupUnavailable: Unavailable: this node has no backup storage configured for the server.
dialog.resetLabel: Reset to the pack's original content
dialog.resetHint: Removes every mod that is not part of the pack, including mods you added yourself.
dialog.keepHint: Mods you added on top of the pack are kept. Mods the new version no longer ships are removed.
dialog.platformLabel: Match the pack's loader and Minecraft version
dialog.platformHint: Switches the server's software to what the pack was built for, so it can start.
dialog.platformChange: This version is built for {{loader}} on Minecraft {{gameVersion}}. The server will be switched to match.
dialog.platformBlocked: This pack needs a different loader or Minecraft version. Turn on matching to install it.
dialog.platformNoPermission: This pack needs a different loader or Minecraft version, and you are not allowed to change the server's build settings.
dialog.resetWarning: Mods you added will be deleted and there is no backup to restore from.

unlinkConfirm.title: Unlink {{title}}?
unlinkConfirm.description: Only the link is dropped. The pack's mods and configuration stay on the server and it keeps running as it does now — but its version can no longer be switched or checked for updates from here, and its jars are listed as hand-uploaded files.

pack.missingFiles_one: {{count}} file of the pack is missing from the server. Reinstall the pack to restore it.
pack.missingFiles_other: {{count}} files of the pack are missing from the server. Reinstall the pack to restore them.
pack.contentsDescription: {{mods}} mods and {{files}} other files come from the pack. Disabled mods stay disabled when the pack is updated.
pack.emptyDescription: Install a modpack and the server gets its mods, configuration, loader and Minecraft version in one step. It stays linked, so updates are one click away.
pack.switchesPlatform: Installing one of these packs switches the server to {{loader}} and the pack's Minecraft version.

mods.dependenciesHint: Required dependencies are installed along with it.

content.title: Content
content.emptyWithPack: Nothing added on top of the modpack yet.

modpackInstall.filesLocked: File editing is disabled until this finishes.
modpackInstall.untouched: Nothing on the server was changed.

modpackInstall.skipped_other: {{count}} files have to be downloaded by hand because their authors block third-party downloads: {{list}}
